THE BLUE EDIT

Handcrafted champagne gold zardozi on deep midnight blue — studio couture campaign & 4K cinema suite.

CLIENT Nilaya Couture
DISCIPLINE Haute Couture · 4K Vertical Cinema & Stills
YEAR 2026
CREDITS / SCOPE Editorial Stills · 4K Film Suite

Chromatic Contrast, Textural Precision.

Conceived against a seamless midnight blue backdrop, this campaign highlights the tactile radiance of champagne gold zardozi, hand-pleated silk, and micro-pearl fringe embellishments. The high-contrast palette creates a modern theatrical stage that elevates classical craftsmanship.

Engineered as an integrated couture campaign package, the suite pairs ultra-high-resolution archival stills with a dedicated 4K vertical cinema master tailored for high-impact social and digital flagships.
